title: My School
ringkas: this/that, there is/are, dan preposisi tempat
goals: menyebut benda di kelas dan tempat di sekolah
memakai [[there is]] dan [[there are]] untuk menyatakan ada
menyebut posisi benda dengan [[in]], [[on]], [[under]], [[next to]], [[behind]], dan lainnya

lesson.text: **Unit 5** membawamu keliling **sekolah**. Kamu belajar menyebut benda di kelas, menunjuk benda yang dekat dan jauh, serta menjelaskan **di mana** sebuah benda berada.

lesson.title: 3. This, that, these, those
lesson.text: Kata-kata ini dipakai untuk **menunjuk**. Pilihannya bergantung pada **jarak** (dekat atau jauh) dan **jumlah** (satu atau banyak).

lesson.title: Singkatan
lesson.text: **That is** boleh disingkat menjadi **that's**. Contoh: [[That's my teacher.]] Tapi **this is** biasanya tidak disingkat.

lesson.title: 4. There is dan there are
lesson.text:
Pakai untuk menyatakan sesuatu **ada**.
• **There is** + benda **satu** (a/an)
• **There are** + benda **banyak** (two, some, many)
table: [[There is a library at my school.]] / [[There are two clocks in the room.]]
[[There isn't a swimming pool.]] / [[There aren't any computers.]]
[[Is there a canteen?]] — Yes, there is. / [[Are there any books?]] — No, there aren't.

examples.en: [[How many chairs are there in your class?]] — [[There are thirty chairs.]]
examples.id: Ada berapa kursi di kelasmu? — Ada tiga puluh kursi.

lesson.title: There is vs There are
lesson.text: Lihat **bendanya**, bukan kata there. Benda satu → **is**: [[There is a book.]] Benda banyak → **are**: [[There are three books.]]

lesson.title: 5. Menyebut posisi (Prepositions of place)
lesson.text: Preposisi menjelaskan **di mana** benda berada, misalnya di atas, di bawah, atau di sebelah.
table: [[The ruler is next to the pencil.]]
[[The eraser is between the pen and the pencil.]]
[[The teacher is in front of the class.]]

lesson.title: 6. Perintah di kelas (Classroom instructions)
lesson.text: Kalimat perintah dimulai dengan **kata kerja dasar**, tanpa subjek. Tambah **please** agar sopan.

items: **this/that** untuk satu benda, **these/those** untuk banyak benda. Dekat = this/these, jauh = that/those.
[[There is]] + satu benda, [[There are]] + banyak benda.
Perintah dimulai dengan kata kerja dasar: [[Open your book, please.]]

read.id:
Ini kelasku. Ada tiga puluh meja dan tiga puluh kursi. Ada papan tulis besar di depan kelas.
Ada jam di dinding di belakang meja guru. Ada dua jendela di sebelah pintu. Tidak ada komputer, tetapi ada perpustakaan kecil di bagian belakang.

qs.q: What is NOT in the classroom?

qs.exp: Teks: "two windows next to the door."

read.text:
This is my classroom. There are thirty desks and thirty chairs. There is a big whiteboard in front of the class.
There is a clock on the wall behind the teacher's desk. There are two windows next to the door. There isn't a computer, but there is a small library at the back.
read.title: Our Classroom

read.id:
Saat istirahat, Dina pergi ke kantin bersama Rani. Kantin berada di antara perpustakaan dan halaman sekolah.
Dina membeli nasi goreng dan segelas teh. Rani membeli roti isi. Mereka makan di bawah pohon besar. Setelah itu, mereka kembali ke kelas.

qs.exp: Teks: "between the library and the school yard."
options: Between the library and the school yard

qs.exp: Teks: "Dina buys fried rice and a glass of tea."
Teks: "They eat under a big tree."
Teks: "they go back to the classroom."
qs.q: What do they do after eating?

read.text:
At break time, Dina goes to the canteen with Rani. The canteen is between the library and the school yard.
Dina buys fried rice and a glass of tea. Rani buys a sandwich. They eat under a big tree. After that, they go back to the classroom.
read.title: Lunch at School
